title: King Oliver's enormous appetite
summary: Phillips describes Oliver's huge breakfast, six feet tall and around 250 pounds, when he hired them.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Was his heart bothering him back then?
No, he was never bothered with no heart. He was bothered with his stomach. He'd eat so much. God, he

could eat! When we first met him, he called us over to tell us about he wanted us with the band, and how he liked the band and everything. He told us to wait until he got through eating breakfast. When he sat down to eat breakfast, he'd eat a half-a-dozen eggs, a half-a-pound of bacon, and a pot of grits, and a pot of coffee, and two sticks of butter, and some preserves or something like that on the side. That's what everybody said: "God, is this man going to eat all this food?" Then when he'd eat all that, he lit up a cigarette and said, "Ah-ha-ha-ha, now we're gonna talk business with you'all." I said, "You should be. You got a whole bushel of food." Oh, he could eat.
He was about six feet. He weighed around about 250 -- somewhere in that neighborhood. He wasn't too big. He was a big-built man.
